text: The owned test removes replaceAll quote stripping and compares the stored To/Cc values directly with quoted display-name strings. Its retained comment still says the helper strips quotes to avoid failing valid strings. The comment no longer describes the assertion contract and should be updated beside these changed checks. The assertion messages themselves are nonempty and describe the expected recipients; this finding concerns the stale explanation, not a missing should word or a fresh test failure.
title: The exact-quote recipient assertions retain an obsolete quote-stripping comment
